verdict.rationale: A business registry with online filing could plausibly offer a test or sandbox filing environment, as some peer registries do, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only the live Online Filing Centre and paper or email channels, and the probe found no documented transactional API on any surface checked. The keyless open.canada.ca open-data API is a different, read-only data service, not a sandbox for testing filings, so it earns no credit.
